record.question: Assume that we have constructor functions for both base class and derived class. Now consider the declaration in main( ). Base * P = New Derived; in what sequence will the constructor be called?
options: Derived class constructor followed by Base class constructor.
Base class constructor followed by derived class constructor.
Base class constructor will not be called.
Derived class constructor will not be called.
